Hello friends, today I bring you another nice map that can be using both for RPG / G mode and Trucker, this is half way first of that style so take into consideration.
What they might find on the map:
- Galpгo ( Materiais e Container)
- A good track that will take you to the city;
- Transport companies, food, mechanics
- Mini airport (used for the profession of aviation and / or cargo transportation)
- Amusement park
- A toll that leads to an extension of the city.
- Two Police station
- Following after the police station, a further 6 diversified companies (which could be used for various transport professions
Print's:
